Messages.Author: Barontinel
Messages.Body:
So here is my question
How does Pressing Flesh work with a Corpse, (lets say with 4 Pathos counters) burned previously in combat.

Can I use it to bring back the corpse? What about the pathos counters?

a/ If the Corpse does not lose his card text there is no pathos counter on it because no blood is wasted and it disapears.

b/ The text is no longer in use and the corpse stays in play....Till I can play Force of Will + Darring and bring it back again for nothing

Pressing Flesh

+1 stealth action.
[thn] Choose an ally that was burned from play. Move that ally from the ash heap to your ready region with this card and life equal to its starting life. This ally is a zombie instead of what it used to be, gets -1 bleed, cannot gain life, and may play cards that require basic [FOR] as a vampire.
[THN] As above, but with an additional life.

Reanimated corpses
Zombie with 2 life. 2 strength. 2 bleed.
[thn] Put X pathos counters on this corpse when it enters play. During your untap pahse, burn 1 pathos counter. Remove the corpse from the game if it has no pathos counters. The corpse can play combat cards that require basic Fortitude as a vampire [THN] as above, but put 2 additional pathos counters on this corpse

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Answer a/ is correct. Reanimated Corpse would be immediately removed from the game :  [LSJ 20100307]

(by the way, I didn't get the part where "you" play Force of Will + Daring the Dawn. The Corpse can't play these cards, I'm not what you were referring to)
